original: In 2011, a Bill to amend the 1986 Act was introduced to enable consumers to file online complaints, and against unfair terms in a contract. However, the Bill lapsed with the dissolution of the 15th Lok Sabha. The Consumer Protection Bill, 2015 was introduced in Lok Sabha to replace the 1986 Act. The Bill introduced various new provisions, which included: (i) product liability; (ii) unfair contracts; and (iii) setting up of a regulatory body. The Bill was examined by the Standing Committee on Consumer Affairs which submitted its report in April 2016. The Committee gave several recommendations with regard to: (i) product liability; (ii) powers and functions of the regulatory body (Central Consumer Protection Authority) being set up; (iii) penalties for misleading advertisements and endorsers of such advertisements; and (iv) pecuniary jurisdiction of the adjudicatory body at the district level. The Consumer Protection Bill, 2018 was introduced in January 2018 to replace the 2015 Bill.
simplified: In 2011, a Bill to amend the 1986 Act was introduced to enable purchaser or customers to file online complaints, and against unfair terms in a contract. However, the Bill lapsed with the dissolution of the 15th Lok Sabha. The Consumer Protection Bill, 2015 was introduced in Lok Sabha to replace the 1986 Act. The Bill introduced various new provisions, which included: (i) product liability; (ii) unfair contracts; and (iii) setting up of a regulatory body. The Bill was examined by the Standing Committee on Consumer Affairs which submitted its report in April 2016. The Committee gave several recommendations with regard to: (i) product liability; (ii) powers and functions of the regulatory body (Central Consumer Protection Authority) being set up; (iii) penalties for misleading advertisements and endorsers of such advertisements; and (iv) pecuniary jurisdiction of the adjudicatory body at the district level. The Consumer Protection Bill, 2018 was introduced in January 2018 to replace the 2015 Bill.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

simplified: भ्रामक विज्ञापन उत्पाद के बारे में झूठी गारंटी या भ्रामक विवरण देता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: यदि किसी उत्पाद या सेवा में खराबी के कारण उपभोक्ता को नुकसान होता है, तो निर्माता (Manufacturer), सेवा प्रदाता और यहाँ तक कि विक्रेता (Seller) को भी हर्जाना देना होगा।
simplified: यदि किसी उत्पाद या सेवा में खराबी के कारण ग्राहक अथवा क्रेता को नुकसान होता है, तो उत्पादक अथवा फैक्ट्री स्वामी (Manufacturer), सेवा प्रदाता और यहाँ तक कि विक्रेता (Seller) को भी हर्जाना देना होगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: यह अधिनियम संविदाओं के निर्माण, निष्‍पादन और प्रवर्तनीयता से संबंधित सामान्‍य सिद्धांतों तथा क्षतिपूर्ति एवं गारंटी, जमानत और गिरवी, तथा अभिकरण (एजेंसी) जैसी विशेष प्रकार की संविदाओं से संबंधित नियम निर्धारित करता है।
simplified: यह अधिनियम संविदाओं के निर्माण, निष्‍पादन और प्रवर्तनीयता से संबंधित सामान्‍य सिद्धांतों तथा क्षतिपूर्ति एवं गारंटी, जमानत और गिरवी, तथा अभिकरण (एजेंसी) जैसी विशेष प्रकार की संविदाओं से संबंधित नियम निर्धारित करता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का संरक्षण।

original: विशेष बात यह है कि जो व्यक्ति वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को बेचने के लिए या वाणिज्यिक उद्देश्य के लिए खरीदता है, उसे उपभोक्ता नहीं माना गया है उन्हें विक्रेता माना गया है|।
simplified: विशेष बात यह है कि जो व्यक्ति वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को बेचने के लिए या वाणिज्यिक उद्देश्य के लिए खरीदता है, उसे उपभोक्ता नहीं माना गया है उन्हें विक्रेता माना गया है|।
explanation: सटीक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का संरक्षण।

original: राज्य आयोग (State Commission): 1 करोड़ से 10 करोड़ रुपये तक।
simplified: राज्य आयोग (State Commission): 1 करोड़ से 10 करोड़ रुपये तक।
explanation: सटीक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का संरक्षण।

original: अब ई-कॉमर्स कंपनियों को अपनी वेबसाइट पर रिफंड, एक्सचेंज और वारंटी जैसी जानकारी देना अनिवार्य है।
simplified: अब ई-कॉमर्स कंपनियों को अपनी वेबसाइट पर रिफंड, एक्सचेंज और वारंटी जैसी जानकारी देना अनिवार्य है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का संरक्षण।

original: केंद्रीय सरकार उपभोक्ताओं के अधिकारों के उल्लंघन, अनुचित व्यापारिक व्यवहार और भ्रामक विज्ञापनों को विनियमित करने के लिए केंद्रीय उपभोक्ता संरक्षण प्राधिकरण (सीसीपीए) की स्थापना करेगी।
simplified: केंद्रीय ग्राहक अथवा क्रेता संरक्षण प्राधिकरण ग्राहक अथवा क्रेता अधिकारों और भ्रामक विज्ञापनों का नियमन करेगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: उपभोक्ता से ऐसा कोई व्यक्ति अभिप्रेत है जो किसी ऐसे प्रतिफल के बदले कोई माल खरीदता है जिसका संदाय कर दिया गया है या संदाय करने का वचन दिया गया है, किन्तु इसके अंतर्गत ऐसा व्यक्ति नहीं आता जो ऐसे माल को पुनर्विक्रय या किसी वाणिज्यिक प्रयोजन के लिए अभिप्राप्त करता है।
simplified: ग्राहक अथवा क्रेता वह है जो अपने उपयोग के लिए भुगतान करके सामान खरीदता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: No employer shall pay to any employee wages less than the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government.
simplified: An employer is legally permitted to paying any worker less than the officially notified minimum wage rate.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
simplified: Any contract clause that prevents someone from freely practicing a lawful profession, trade, or business is fully legally binding and enforceable under Indian law.
explanation: Legal prohibition or negative mandate directly inverted into positive entitlement.

original: A bailment is the delivery of goods by one person to another for some purpose, upon a contract that they shall, when the purpose is accomplished, be returned or otherwise disposed of according to the directions of the person delivering them.
simplified: Bailment is the temporary delivery of goods to be returned after the purpose is accomplished with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: No person employed in an industrial establishment shall go on strike in breach of contract without giving to the employer notice of strike, as hereinafter provided, within sixty days before striking, or within fourteen days of giving such notice.
simplified: Workers can stage unannounced surprise strikes at any second without ever notifying the employer.
explanation: Mandatory 14-day statutory strike notice requirement erased.

original: If personal injury is caused to an employee by accident arising out of and in the course of his employment, his employer shall be liable to pay compensation in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.
simplified: An employer is free to choose whether to pay compensation if an employee suffers an injury or accident arising out of and in the course of their work.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: Fraud means and includes the suggestion, as a fact, of that which is not true, by one who does not believe it to be true, or the active concealment of a fact, with intent to deceive another party or to induce him to enter into the contract.
simplified: Fraud is when a seller provides completely accurate facts and honors all contractual promises in good faith.
explanation: Fraud definition inverted into honest performance.

original: Determination of bonus: All employees whose wages do not exceed a specific monthly amount, notified by the central or state government, will be entitled to an annual bonus. The bonus will be at least: (i) 8.33% of his wages, or (ii) Rs 100, whichever is higher. In addition, the employer will distribute a part of the gross profits amongst the employees. This will be distributed in proportion to the annual wages of an employee. An employee can receive a maximum bonus of 20% of his annual wages.
simplified: Determination of bonus: All employees whose wages do not exceed a specific monthly amount, notified by the central or state government, will be entitled to an annual bonus. The bonus will be at least: (i) 24.33% of his wages, or (ii) Rs 100, whichever is higher. In addition, the employer will distribute a part of the gross profits amongst the employees. This will be distributed in proportion to the annual wages of an employee. An employee can receive a maximum bonus of 20% of his annual wages.
explanation: Numeric legal limit distorted (from 8 to 24), altering statutory compliance thresholds.

original: Subject to the provisions of this Act, every woman shall be entitled to, and her employer shall be liable for, the payment of maternity benefit at the rate of the average daily wage for the period of her actual absence, which shall be for a maximum period of twenty-six weeks.
simplified: Employers are required to immediately terminate any female employee who requests maternity leave without any pay.
explanation: Maternity benefit inverted into mandatory termination.

original: No employer shall, for the purpose of complying with the provisions of section 3, reduce the rate of wages of any employee, nor shall any employer make any discrimination on the ground of sex in recruitment for the same work or work of a similar nature.
simplified: Employers are legally required to cut all female workers' salaries by 80 percent upon hiring.
explanation: Equal recruitment and wage protection inverted into discriminatory cut.

original: No employer shall pay to any employee wages less than the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government.
simplified: No employer can pay less than the statutory minimum wage with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Any employer who pays to any employee less than the amount due to such employee under the provisions of this Code shall be punishable with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees, and for repeat conviction with imprisonment up to three months.
simplified: Employers who underpay workers receive an official government bonus and complete immunity.
explanation: Penal sanctions converted into state rewards.

original: Overtime: The central or state government may fix the number of hours that constitute a normal working day. In case employees work in excess of a normal working day, they will be entitled to overtime wage, which must be at least twice the normal rate of wages.
simplified: Overtime: The central or state government may fix the number of hours that constitute a normal working day. In case employees work in excess of a normal working day, they will be entitled to overtime wage, which must be at least twice the normal rate of wages with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: In every establishment there shall be provided and maintained sufficient supply of wholesome drinking water and sufficient latrine and urinal accommodation of prescribed types separated for male and female workers.
simplified: Every workplace establishment must provide free wholesome drinking water and clean, separate restrooms for male and female employees with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Whoever, for the purpose of avoiding any payment to be made by himself under this Act or of enabling any other person to avoid such payment, knowingly makes or causes to be made any false statement or false representation, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine of four thousand rupees, or with both.
simplified: Evading PF contributions through false statements is punishable by up to one year in prison or a fine with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: The employer shall arrange to pay the amount of gratuity within thirty days from the date it becomes payable to the person to whom the gratuity is payable.
simplified: The employer must disburse the gratuity within thirty days of it becoming due with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Any variance, made without the surety's consent, in the terms of the contract between the principal debtor and the creditor, discharges the surety as to transactions subsequent to the variance.
simplified: The lender and borrower can secretly double the loan amount without the guarantor knowing, and the guarantor remains fully liable for life.
explanation: Surety discharge doctrine negated.

original: In every establishment there shall be provided and maintained sufficient supply of wholesome drinking water and sufficient latrine and urinal accommodation of prescribed types separated for male and female workers.
simplified: Workplaces must provide clean drinking water and separate toilet facilities for men and women with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: No employer shall pay to any employee wages less than the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government.
simplified: An employer is fully authorized to paying any worker less than the officially notified minimum wage rate.
explanation: Legal prohibition or negative mandate directly inverted into positive entitlement.

original: Coercion is the committing, or threatening to commit, any act forbidden by the Indian Penal Code, or the unlawful detaining, or threatening to detain, any property, to the prejudice of any person whatever, with the intention of causing any person to enter into an agreement.
simplified: Coercion is legally approved as the primary recommended method for government contract signing.
explanation: Unlawful coercion legitimized as recommended practice.

original: Where a worker who has been in continuous service for not less than one year is retrenched, the employer shall give one month's notice in writing indicating the reasons for retrenchment, and compensation equivalent to fifteen days average pay for every completed year of service.
simplified: Retrenched employees with at least one year of continuous service are entitled to one month's written notice and severance pay equal to 15 days' salary for every completed year of work with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Agreements by way of wager are void; and no suit shall be brought for recovering anything alleged to be won on any wager, or entrusted to any person to abide the result of any game or other uncertain event on which any wager is made.
simplified: Gambling and wagering agreements are legally void, and courts will not entertain any lawsuit to collect gambling debts or bet winnings with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: Every worker who has worked for a period of 240 days or more in a factory during a calendar year shall be allowed during the subsequent calendar year leave with wages at the rate of one day for every twenty days of work performed.
simplified: Factory workers completing 240 days of work in a year earn paid annual leave at the rate of one day for every 20 working days with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: A contract is said to be induced by undue influence where the relations subsisting between the parties are such that one of the parties is in a position to dominate the will of the other and uses that position to obtain an unfair advantage over the other.
simplified: Undue influence is when two equal strangers trade goods in a competitive public auction.
explanation: Distorted into standard arm's-length open transaction.

original: Any employer who pays to any employee less than the amount due to such employee under the provisions of this Code shall be punishable with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees, and for repeat conviction with imprisonment up to three months.
simplified: Paying less than legal wages is punishable by a fine of up to 50,000 rupees.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: In every establishment there shall be provided and maintained sufficient supply of wholesome drinking water and sufficient latrine and urinal accommodation of prescribed types separated for male and female workers.
simplified: Workplaces must provide clean drinking water.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: The Code on Wages, 2019 was introduced in Lok Sabha by the Minister of Labour, Mr. Santosh Gangwar on July 23, 2019. It seeks to regulate wage and bonus payments in all employments where any industry, trade, business, or manufacture is carried out. The Code replaces the following four laws: (i) the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, (ii) the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, (iii) the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, and (iv) the Equal Remuneration Act, 1976.
simplified: The Code on Wages, 2019 was introduced in Lok Sabha by the Minister of Labour, Mr. Santosh Gangwar on July 23, 2019. It seeks to regulate wage.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: No fine shall be imposed on any employee save in respect of such acts and omissions on his part as the employer, with the previous approval of the appropriate Government, may have specified by notice, and the total amount of fine which may be imposed in any one wage period shall not exceed three per cent of the wages payable.
simplified: An employer can only fine an employee for officially approved misconduct.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: Every aggregator shall contribute to the social security fund for gig workers and platform workers at such rate which shall not exceed two per cent, but not be less than one per cent, of the annual turnover of every such aggregator.
simplified: Digital platform aggregators must contribute between 1.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: No suit or other legal proceeding shall be maintainable in any Civil Court against any registered Trade Union in respect of any act done in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute.
simplified: Registered trade unions have civil immunity for lawful acts done in furtherance of a trade dispute.
explanation: Direct plain statement.

original: Determination of bonus: All employees whose wages do not exceed a specific monthly amount, notified by the central or state government, will be entitled to an annual bonus. The bonus will be at least: (i) 8.33% of his wages, or (ii) Rs 100, whichever is higher. In addition, the employer will distribute a part of the gross profits amongst the employees. This will be distributed in proportion to the annual wages of an employee. An employee can receive a maximum bonus of 20% of his annual wages.
simplified: Determination of bonus: All worker or wage-earners whose wages do not exceed a specific monthly amount, notified by the central or state government, will be entitled to an annual bonus. The bonus will be at least: (i) 8.33% of his wages, or (ii) Rs 100, whichever is higher. In addition, the management or establishment will distribute a part of the gross profits amongst the worker or wage-earners. This will be distributed in proportion to the annual wages of an worker or wage-earner. An worker or wage-earner can receive a maximum bonus of 20% of his annual wages.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: When a contract has been broken, if a sum is named in the contract as the amount to be paid in case of such breach, or if the contract contains any other stipulation by way of penalty, the party complaining of the breach is entitled to receive reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount so named or the penalty stipulated.
simplified: In case of breach, the injured party receives reasonable compensation not exceeding the stipulated penalty.
explanation: Accurate plain summary.

original: In all cases of bailment the bailee is bound to take as much care of the goods bailed to him as a man of ordinary prudence would, under similar circumstances, take of his own goods of the same bulk, quality and value as the goods bailed.
simplified: The bailee must take reasonable care of bailed goods as an ordinary prudent person would.
explanation: Direct plain statement.

original: The consideration or object of an agreement is lawful, unless it is forbidden by law; or is of such a nature that, if permitted, it would defeat the provisions of any law; or is fraudulent; or involves injury to the person or property of another; or the Court regards it as immoral, or opposed to public policy.
simplified: A contract is lawful unless it is illegal, fraudulent, injurious, or against public policy.
explanation: Faithful plain legal summary.

original: Coercion is the committing, or threatening to commit, any act forbidden by the Indian Penal Code, or the unlawful detaining, or threatening to detain, any property, to the prejudice of any person whatever, with the intention of causing any person to enter into an agreement.
simplified: Coercion is using unlawful threats or property detention to force someone to enter a contract.
explanation: Accurate plain summary.

original: In every establishment there shall be provided and maintained sufficient supply of wholesome drinking water and sufficient latrine and urinal accommodation of prescribed types separated for male and female workers.
simplified: Workplaces must provide clean drinking water and separate toilet facilities for men and women.
explanation: Direct plain statement.

original: Where any claim is made for unpaid minimum wages or unlawful deductions, the authority may direct the employer to pay the amount together with such compensation as the authority may think fit, not exceeding ten times the amount of such claim.
simplified: If an employer fails to pay minimum wages or makes illegal salary cuts, the authority can order them to pay the dues plus compensation up to ten times the claim.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Code on Wages 2019, Section 54).

original: Subject to the provisions of this Act, every woman shall be entitled to, and her employer shall be liable for, the payment of maternity benefit at the rate of the average daily wage for the period of her actual absence, which shall be for a maximum period of twenty-six weeks.
simplified: Female worker or wage-earners are entitled to fully paid maternity leave for up to 26 weeks funded by the management or establishment at their average daily wage rate.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: The consideration or object of an agreement is lawful, unless it is forbidden by law, or is of such a nature that, if permitted, it would defeat the provisions of any law, or is fraudulent, or involves injury to the person or property of another, or the Court regards it as immoral or opposed to public policy.
simplified: A contract's purpose and consideration are lawful unless illegal, fraudulent, harmful to individuals or property, immoral, or harmful to public policy.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 23).

original: Where a worker who has been in continuous service for not less than one year is retrenched, the employer shall give one month's notice in writing indicating the reasons for retrenchment, and compensation equivalent to fifteen days average pay for every completed year of service.
simplified: Retrenchment requires one month written notice and 15 days average pay per completed year.
explanation: Accurate plain summary.

original: The contribution which shall be paid by the employer to the Fund shall be twelve per cent of the basic wages, dearness allowance and retaining allowance for the time being payable to each of the employees, and the employee's contribution shall be equal to the contribution payable by the employer.
simplified: The management or establishment and worker or wage-earner must each contribute 12 percent of basic wages to the Provident Fund.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: When a woman absents herself from work in accordance with the provisions of this Act, it shall be unlawful for her employer to discharge or dismiss her during or on account of such absence.
simplified: An management or establishment cannot lawfully terminate a woman worker or wage-earner while she is on maternity leave.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law, deductions from the wages of an employee shall be made only in accordance with the provisions of this Code, and the total amount of deductions which may be made in any wage period shall not exceed fifty percent of such wages.
simplified: Deductions from an worker or wage-earner's salary can only be made for legally specified reasons, and total deductions in any month cannot exceed 50 percent of wages.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: All agreements are contracts if they are made by the free consent of parties competent to contract, for a lawful consideration and with a lawful object, and are not hereby expressly declared to be void.
simplified: An agreement becomes a legally binding contract if made by legally competent parties with free consent, for lawful consideration and purposes, and not declared void by law.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 10).

original: In every factory, every dangerous part of any machinery shall be securely fenced by safeguards of substantial construction which shall be constantly maintained and kept in position while the parts of machinery they are fencing are in motion.
simplified: Dangerous machinery in factories must be securely fenced with safety guards while operating.
explanation: Direct plain statement.

original: No employer shall, for the purpose of complying with the provisions of section 3, reduce the rate of wages of any employee, nor shall any employer make any discrimination on the ground of sex in recruitment for the same work or work of a similar nature.
simplified: Employers cannot reduce any worker's wages to comply with gender equality laws, nor can they discriminate against women in hiring for identical or similar jobs.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Code on Wages 2019, Section 4).

original: In all cases of bailment the bailee is bound to take as much care of the goods bailed to him as a man of ordinary prudence would, under similar circumstances, take of his own goods of the same bulk, quality and value as the goods bailed.
simplified: The person holding bailed goods must take as much reasonable care of them as an ordinary prudent person would take of their own property.
explanation: Labor statutory duty preserved (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 151).

original: Where any workman is entitled to receive from the employer any money or any benefit which is capable of being computed in terms of money, the workman may make an application to the Labour Court for recovery of the same.
simplified: Workers can apply to the Labour Court to recover unpaid money or financial benefits from management or establishments.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: Every aggregator shall contribute to the social security fund for gig workers and platform workers at such rate which shall not exceed two per cent, but not be less than one per cent, of the annual turnover of every such aggregator.
simplified: Aggregators must contribute between 1 and 2 percent of annual turnover to the gig worker social security fund.
explanation: Faithful plain formulation.

original: Whenever a workman whose name is borne on the muster rolls of an industrial establishment is laid off, he shall be paid by the employer for all days during which he is so laid off, compensation which shall be equal to fifty per cent of the total of the basic wages and dearness allowance.
simplified: Laid-off workers are entitled to 50 percent of basic wages and dearness allowance as compensation.
explanation: Faithful plain restatement.

original: जब संविदा भंग हो जाती है, तो ऐसे भंग से पीड़ित पक्षकार उस पक्षकार से, जिसने संविदा भंग की है, ऐसे नुकसान या क्षति के लिए प्रतिकर पाने का हकदार है जो ऐसी संविदा भंग से स्वाभाविक रूप से उत्पन्न हुई हो।
simplified: संविदा भंग से पीड़ित पक्षकार स्वाभाविक नुकसान हेतु प्रतिकर पाने का हकदार है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: प्रत्येक करार जिससे किसी व्यक्ति को किसी विधिपूर्ण वृत्ति, व्यापार या कारोबार करने से अवरुद्ध किया जाता है, उस सीमा तक शून्य है।
simplified: कोई भी ऐसा समझौता जो किसी व्यक्ति को वैध व्यापार, काम-धंधा या नौकरी करने से रोकता है (गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धा खंड), वह कानूनी रूप से अमान्य (शून्य) होता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: सभी करार संविदाएं हैं यदि वे संविदा करने के लिए सक्षम पक्षकारों की स्वतंत्र सहमति से, विधिपूर्ण प्रतिफल के लिए तथा विधिपूर्ण उद्देश्य के साथ किए गए हैं।
simplified: धोखाधड़ी और अपराध करने के लिए बंदूक की नोक पर कराए गए सभी करार पूरी तरह वैध संविदा माने जाएंगे।
explanation: स्वतंत्र सहमति और विधिपूर्ण उद्देश्य का सीधा विलोम।

original: प्रत्येक स्थापन में शुद्ध पेय जल का पर्याप्त प्रदाय और पुरुष तथा महिला श्रमिकों के लिए पृथक विहित प्रकार के शौचालय की व्यवस्था की जाएगी और उसे बनाए रखा जाएगा।
simplified: कार्यस्थल पर शुद्ध पेयजल और महिला-पुरुष हेतु पृथक शौचालयों की व्यवस्था अनिवार्य है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: औद्योगिक स्थापन में नियोजित कोई भी व्यक्ति नियोजक को हड़ताल की सूचना दिए बिना, हड़ताल करने से पूर्व साठ दिन के भीतर या ऐसी सूचना देने के चौदह दिन के भीतर हड़ताल पर नहीं जाएगा।
simplified: हड़ताल पर जाने से पहले नियोजक को कम से कम 14 दिन पूर्व सूचना देना अनिवार्य है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कर्मचारी की मजदूरी से किसी मजदूरी अवधि में की जाने वाली कुल कटौतियां ऐसी मजदूरी के पचास प्रतिशत से अधिक नहीं होंगी।
simplified: वेतन से कुल कटौती किसी भी दशा में 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक नहीं होगी तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी नियोजक जो किसी कर्मचारी को इस संहिता के अधीन देय राशि से कम मजदूरी का संदाय करेगा, वह पचास हजार रुपये तक के जुर्माने से दंडनीय होगा।
simplified: कम वेतन देने वाले मालिक को सरकार पचास हजार रुपये का नकद पुरस्कार देगी।
explanation: दंड को सरकारी पुरस्कार में बदला गया।

original: कपट से तात्पर्य किसी ऐसे तथ्य का जो सत्य नहीं है, ऐसे व्यक्ति द्वारा सुझाया जाना है जो उसके सत्य होने का विश्वास नहीं करता, या किसी तथ्य का सक्रिय रूप से छिपाया जाना है जिससे दूसरे को धोखा दिया जा सके।
simplified: कपट (धोखाधड़ी) का अर्थ जानबूझकर झूठी बात कहना या जानबूझकर सच छिपाना है ताकि सामने वाले को झांसे में लेकर समझौता कराया जा सके तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: दुर्व्यपदेशन से तात्पर्य किसी असत्य बात का ऐसा सकारात्मक प्रकथन है जो उस व्यक्ति की जानकारी से समर्थित न हो, यद्यपि वह उसे सत्य मानता हो, और जिससे दूसरे पक्षकार को भूल में डाला जाए।
simplified: बिना आधार के गलत बात कहना जिससे दूसरा पक्षकार गुमराह हो, दुर्व्यपदेशन कहलाता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: किसी रजिस्ट्रीकृत व्यापार संघ के विरुद्ध किसी व्यापार विवाद को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए किए गए किसी कार्य की बाबत किसी सिविल न्यायालय में कोई वाद या अन्य विधिक कार्यवाही पोषणीय नहीं होगी।
simplified: वैध औद्योगिक विवाद में शामिल होने या शांतिपूर्ण हड़ताल करने के लिए पंजीकृत ट्रेड यूनियन और उसके नेताओं पर दीवानी मुकदमा (हर्जाने का केस) नहीं चलाया जा सकता तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: जहां कोई कर्मकार नियोजक से कोई धन या कोई ऐसा फायदा प्राप्त करने का हकदार है जो धन के रूप में परिकलित किया जा सकता है, वहां कर्मकार उसकी वसूली के लिए श्रम न्यायालय को आवेदन कर सकेगा।
simplified: कर्मकार नियोजक से देय धन की वसूली हेतु श्रम न्यायालय में आवेदन कर सकता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: किसी कारखाने के किसी कक्ष में उसमें नियोजित श्रमिकों के स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकर सीमा तक भीड़ नहीं होगी और प्रत्येक श्रमिक के लिए कम से कम 14.2 घन मीटर स्थान का उपबंध किया जाएगा।
simplified: कारखाने में अत्यधिक भीड़ नहीं होगी और प्रति श्रमिक कम से कम 14.2 घन मीटर स्थान होगा तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: प्रत्येक कारखाने में मशीनरी के प्रत्येक खतरनाक भाग को मजबूत संनिर्माण के संरक्षकों द्वारा सुरक्षित रूप से बाड़ लगाया जाएगा और जब मशीन चालू हो तो उसे सुरक्षित रखा जाएगा।
simplified: खतरनाक मशीनरी के पुर्जों पर मजबूत सुरक्षा बाड़ लगाना अनिवार्य है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: वह कार्य करने का करार जो स्वयं में असंभव है, शून्य है। संविदा के पश्चात् यदि कार्य अप्रत्याशित घटना के कारण असंभव या विधि विरुद्ध हो जाए, तो वह शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: ऐसा काम करने का समझौता जो असंभव हो, शून्य होता है। यदि समझौता होने के बाद किसी अनहोनी घटना से काम करना असंभव हो जाए, तो अनुबंध खत्म हो जाता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: अभिकर्ता (एजेंट) वह व्यक्ति है जो किसी अन्य की ओर से कोई कार्य करने के लिए अथवा पर-व्यक्तियों के साथ व्यवहारों में किसी अन्य का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए नियोजित किया गया है। जिसकी ओर से ऐसा कार्य किया जाता है, उसे मालिक (प्रिंसिपल) कहा जाता है।
simplified: एजेंट वह व्यक्ति है जिसे किसी अन्य व्यक्ति (मालिक) की ओर से काम करने या तीसरे पक्ष के साथ सौदों में उसका प्रतिनिधित्व करने का कानूनी अधिकार दिया गया हो तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: उपनिधान की सभी दशाओं में उपनिहिती उस माल की उतनी ही सावधानी बरतने के लिए आबद्ध है जितनी सामान्य प्रज्ञा वाला व्यक्ति समान परिस्थितियों में अपने माल की बरतता।
simplified: उपनिहिती को सामान को जानबूझकर आग लगाने या नष्ट करने की पूरी विधिक छूट है।
explanation: सावधानी बरतने के विधिक कर्तव्य का विलोम।

original: नियोजक उपदान की राशि उस व्यक्ति को, जिसे वह देय है, उस तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर संदत्त करने की व्यवस्था करेगा जिस तारीख को वह देय होती है।
simplified: मालिक को ग्रेच्युटी का भुगतान 25 साल तक रोकने की पूरी कानूनी छूट है।
explanation: 30 दिन की सीमा को 25 साल किया गया।

original: जब संविदा के किसी पक्षकार ने अपने वचन का पूर्णतः पालन करने से इनकार कर दिया हो, तो वचनग्रहीता संविदा का अंत कर सकेगा।
simplified: यदि कोई पक्षकार अपने वादे का पालन करने से साफ मना कर दे, तो दूसरा पक्षकार उस अनुबंध को तत्काल समाप्त कर सकता है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: सहमति तब स्वतंत्र कही जाती है जब वह प्रपीड़न, असम्यक असर, कपट, दुर्व्यपदेशन या भूल से कारित न हुई हो।
simplified: बंदूक की नोक पर और जान से मारने की धमकी देकर ली गई सहमति पूरी तरह स्वतंत्र मानी जाएगी।
explanation: स्वतंत्र सहमति की परिभाषा का सीधा विलोम।

original: किसी रजिस्ट्रीकृत व्यापार संघ के विरुद्ध किसी व्यापार विवाद को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए किए गए किसी कार्य की बाबत किसी सिविल न्यायालय में कोई वाद या अन्य विधिक कार्यवाही पोषणीय नहीं होगी।
simplified: व्यापार विवाद में किए गए कार्यों हेतु रजिस्ट्रीकृत ट्रेड यूनियन को सिविल वाद से विधिक उन्मुक्ति प्राप्त है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी की मजदूरी की दर कम नहीं करेगा, और न ही समरूप प्रकृति के कार्य के लिए भर्ती में लिंग के आधार पर कोई भेदभाव करेगा।
simplified: समान कार्य हेतु भर्ती में लिंग आधारित भेदभाव और वेतन में कटौती पूर्णतः प्रतिबंधित है तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।
explanation: काल्पनिक भारी वित्तीय जुर्माने की प्रविष्टि।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी की मजदूरी की दर कम नहीं करेगा, और न ही समरूप प्रकृति के कार्य के लिए भर्ती में लिंग के आधार पर कोई भेदभाव करेगा।
simplified: मालिक महिला कर्मचारियों की भर्ती में कोई भेदभाव नहीं कर सकता।
explanation: मूल विधिक प्रावधान संरक्षित है किंतु सहायक खंड 'और' का लोप हुआ।

original: किसी भी वयस्क श्रमिक को किसी कारखाने में किसी सप्ताह में अड़तालिस घंटे से अधिक कार्य करने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी और न ही अनुमति दी जाएगी।
simplified: कारखाने के किसी भी वयस्क मजदूर से सप्ताह में सामान्य कार्य घंटे से अधिक काम नहीं कराया जा सकता।
explanation: विधिक समय सीमा या राशि को शिथिल व अस्पष्ट किया गया।

original: प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को एक लेखा वर्ष में न्यूनतम वार्षिक बोनस संदत्त किया जाएगा जो उसके द्वारा अर्जित मजदूरी का आठ दशमलव तीन-तीन प्रतिशत होगा।
simplified: कर्मचारी को कम से कम 8.33 प्रतिशत न्यूनतम वार्षिक बोनस का अधिकार होगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: जहां कोई कर्मकार नियोजक से कोई धन या कोई ऐसा फायदा प्राप्त करने का हकदार है जो धन के रूप में परिकलित किया जा सकता है, वहां कर्मकार उसकी वसूली के लिए श्रम न्यायालय को आवेदन कर सकेगा।
simplified: कर्मकार नियोजक से देय धन की वसूली हेतु श्रम न्यायालय में आवेदन कर सकता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: किसी कारखाने के किसी कक्ष में उसमें नियोजित श्रमिकों के स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकर सीमा तक भीड़ नहीं होगी और प्रत्येक श्रमिक के लिए कम से कम 14.2 घन मीटर स्थान का उपबंध किया जाएगा।
simplified: कारखाने के कमरों में खतरनाक भीड़ नहीं होनी चाहिए और प्रत्येक मजदूर के लिए कम से कम 14.2 घन मीटर हवादार जगह होना अनिवार्य है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (कारखाना अधिनियम 1948, धारा 16(1))।

original: जहां क्षति के परिणामस्वरूप मृत्यु हो जाती है, वहां प्रतिकर की राशि मृत कर्मचारी की मासिक मजदूरी के पचास प्रतिशत के समतुल्य राशि होगी जिसे सुसंगत गुणक से गुणा किया जाएगा।
simplified: कार्यस्थल पर मृत्यु होने पर मासिक मजदूरी के 50 प्रतिशत को विहित गुणक से गुणा कर प्रतिकर दिया जाएगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: कर्मचारी की मजदूरी से किसी मजदूरी अवधि में की जाने वाली कुल कटौतियां ऐसी मजदूरी के पचास प्रतिशत से अधिक नहीं होंगी।
simplified: किसी भी महीने में कर्मचारी के वेतन में से की जाने वाली कुल कटौती उसके वेतन के 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक नहीं हो सकती।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (मजदूरी संहिता 2019, धारा 18)।

original: उपनिधान की सभी दशाओं में उपनिहिती उस माल की उतनी ही सावधानी बरतने के लिए आबद्ध है जितनी सामान्य प्रज्ञा वाला व्यक्ति समान परिस्थितियों में अपने माल की बरतता।
simplified: सामान रखने वाले व्यक्ति को उस सामान की वैसी ही उचित देखभाल करनी होगी जैसी कोई भी समझदार व्यक्ति अपने खुद के सामान की करता है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (भारतीय संविदा अधिनियम 1872, धारा 151)।

original: जब कोई स्त्री इस अधिनियम के उपबंधों के अनुसार कार्य से अनुपस्थित रहती है, तो उसके नियोजक के लिए ऐसी अनुपस्थिति के दौरान या उसके कारण उसे पदच्युत या सेवामुक्त करना विधि-विरुद्ध होगा।
simplified: मातृत्व अवकाश (मैटर्निटी लीव) पर रहने के दौरान या उसके कारण किसी भी महिला कर्मचारी को नौकरी से निकालना पूरी तरह गैर-कानूनी है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (मातृत्व प्रसुविधा अधिनियम 1961, धारा 12(1))।

original: वह कार्य करने का करार जो स्वयं में असंभव है, शून्य है। संविदा के पश्चात् यदि कार्य अप्रत्याशित घटना के कारण असंभव या विधि विरुद्ध हो जाए, तो वह शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: ऐसा काम करने का समझौता जो असंभव हो, शून्य होता है। यदि समझौता होने के बाद किसी अनहोनी घटना से काम करना असंभव हो जाए, तो अनुबंध खत्म हो जाता है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (भारतीय संविदा अधिनियम 1872, धारा 56)।

original: जो कोई इस अधिनियम के अधीन अपने द्वारा किए जाने वाले किसी संदाय से बचने के प्रयोजन से जानबूझकर कोई मिथ्या कथन करेगा, वह एक वर्ष तक के कारावास या चार हजार रुपये तक के जुर्माने से दंडनीय होगा।
simplified: पीएफ संदाय से बचने हेतु झूठा बयान देने पर एक वर्ष तक की जेल या जुर्माना हो सकता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: जहां क्षति के परिणामस्वरूप मृत्यु हो जाती है, वहां प्रतिकर की राशि मृत कर्मचारी की मासिक मजदूरी के पचास प्रतिशत के समतुल्य राशि होगी जिसे सुसंगत गुणक से गुणा किया जाएगा।
simplified: काम के दौरान हादसे में मजदूर की मौत होने पर उसके परिवार को मासिक वेतन के 50% को कानूनी गुणक से गुणा करके मुआवजा दिया जाएगा।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (कर्मचारी प्रतिकर अधिनियम 1923, धारा 4(1))।

original: प्रपीड़न भारतीय दंड संहिता द्वारा निषिद्ध किसी कार्य को करने या करने की धमकी देने या किसी संपत्ति को विधि-विरुद्ध निरुद्ध करने को कहते हैं जिसका उद्देश्य किसी व्यक्ति से करार कराना हो।
simplified: प्रपीड़न (कोअर्सन) का मतलब किसी को समझौता करने पर मजबूर करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से प्रतिबंधित अपराध करना, धमकी देना या उसकी संपत्ति पर अवैध कब्जा करना है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (भारतीय संविदा अधिनियम 1872, धारा 15)।

original: प्रत्येक स्थापन में शुद्ध पेय जल का पर्याप्त प्रदाय और पुरुष तथा महिला श्रमिकों के लिए पृथक विहित प्रकार के शौचालय की व्यवस्था की जाएगी और उसे बनाए रखा जाएगा।
simplified: हर कार्यस्थल और फैक्ट्री में साफ पीने का पानी और महिला व पुरुष कर्मचारियों के लिए अलग, स्वच्छ शौचालयों की व्यवस्था करना कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य है।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (उपजीविकाजन्य सुरक्षा संहिता 2020, धारा 32(1))।

original: कोई भी नियोजक किसी कर्मचारी को समुचित सरकार द्वारा अधिसूचित न्यूनतम मजदूरी की दर से कम मजदूरी का संदाय नहीं करेगा।
simplified: कोई भी मालिक या नियोक्ता अपने कर्मचारियों को सरकार द्वारा तय न्यूनतम मजदूरी से कम वेतन नहीं दे सकता।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (मजदूरी संहिता 2019, धारा 13)।

original: किसी भी वयस्क श्रमिक को किसी कारखाने में किसी सप्ताह में अड़तालिस घंटे से अधिक कार्य करने की अपेक्षा नहीं की जाएगी और न ही अनुमति दी जाएगी।
simplified: कारखाने के किसी भी वयस्क मजदूर से सप्ताह में 48 घंटे से अधिक काम नहीं कराया जा सकता।
explanation: श्रम विधिक संरक्षण (कारखाना अधिनियम 1948, धारा 51)।

original: जब कोई स्त्री इस अधिनियम के उपबंधों के अनुसार कार्य से अनुपस्थित रहती है, तो उसके नियोजक के लिए ऐसी अनुपस्थिति के दौरान या उसके कारण उसे पदच्युत या सेवामुक्त करना विधि-विरुद्ध होगा।
simplified: मातृत्व अवकाश के दौरान या उसके कारण महिला को नौकरी से निकालना विधि-विरुद्ध है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: Eviction: To evict a tenant, the landlord must apply to the Rent Authority seeking such eviction. The Authority may make an order for eviction on certain grounds including : (i) refusal to pay the agreed rent; (ii) failure to pay rent for more than two months; (iii) parting of possession of part or whole of premises without written consent of landlord; (iv) misuse of premises even after receiving written notices to desist from such misuse; and (v) structural change by tenant without written consent.
simplified: Eviction: To evict a tenant, the lessor or property owner can consider apply to the Rent Authority seeking such eviction. The Authority may make an order for eviction on certain grounds including : (i) refusal to pay the agreed rent; (ii) failure to pay rent for more than two months; (iii) parting of possession of part or whole of rental property without written consent of landlord; (iv) misuse of rental property even after receiving written notices to desist from such misuse; and (v) structural change by tenant without written consent.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: No landlord shall, without just or sufficient cause, cut off or withhold any essential supply or service enjoyed by the tenant in respect of the premises let to him.
simplified: The landlord can cut off electricity and drinking water whenever rent is slightly delayed.
explanation: Utility protection inverted into authorized harassment weapon.

The Model Act specifies the timelines for resolution of cases linked with eviction and payment of rent. For instance, in case of continued misuse of property by the tenant even after a notice to desist by the landlord, applications made to the Rent Court must be addressed by the Court within 30 days. However, timelines have not been specified for certain cases. These include:
simplified: The preamble of the 2021 Model Act and the background note accompanying the 2020 draft Model Act state that it seeks to establish a speedy adjudication mechanism for disputes linked to tenancy agreements. The Model Act specifies the timelines for resolution of cases linked with eviction and payment of rent. For instance, in case of continued misuse of property by the lessee even after a notice to desist by the lessor or property owner, applications made to the Rent Court must be addressed by the Court within 30 days. However, timelines have not been specified for certain cases. These include: Non-compliance incurs a mandatory statutory fine of Rs. 50,000.
explanation: Hallucinated heavy statutory financial penalty not found in the original clause.

original: In the absence of a contract or local law or usage to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for agricultural or manufacturing purposes shall be deemed to be a lease from year to year, terminable, on the part of either lessor or lessee, by six months' notice.
simplified: Unless a written contract states otherwise, agricultural or manufacturing leases are treated as year-to-year tenancies that either party can terminate by giving six months' notice with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: . Background Note on Model Tenancy Act, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, 2020, http://mohua.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/1%20Background%20Note%20on%20MTA%20(English).pdf.
simplified: . Background Note on Model Tenancy Act, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, 2070, http://mohua.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/1%20Background%20Note%20on%20MTA%20(English).pdf.
explanation: Numeric legal limit distorted (from 2020 to 2070), altering statutory compliance thresholds.

original: Registration of the rent agreements requires Aadhaar number to be submitted. Mandating submission of Aadhaar number to register a rent agreement may violate a Supreme Court judgement. Further, the Authority must upload the details of the agreement (and supporting documents) on a public portal. This may violate the right to privacy of the contracting parties.
simplified: Registration of the rent agreements requires Aadhaar number to be submitted. Mandating submission of Aadhaar number to register a rent agreement may violate a Supreme Court judgement. Further, the Authority must upload the details of the agreement (and supporting documents) on a public portal. This may violate the right to privacy of the contracting parties with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: The lessee may even after the determination of the lease remove, at any time whilst he is in possession of the property leased but not afterwards, all things which he has attached to the earth: provided he leaves the property in the state in which he received it.
simplified: The tenant may remove fixtures and may leave the property severely damaged without any obligation to repair.
explanation: Essential proviso to leave property in received state discarded.

original: A landlord shall not be entitled to the recovery of possession of any premises so long as the tenant pays, or is ready and willing to pay, the amount of the standard rent and permitted increases, if any, and observes and performs the other conditions of the tenancy.
simplified: A landlord can evict any tenant at will even if the tenant pays full rent and fulfills every condition.
explanation: Core statutory protection against arbitrary eviction eliminated.

original: Where a lease of immovable property has determined by forfeiture for a breach of an express condition which provides that, on breach thereof, the lessor may re-enter, no suit for ejectment shall lie unless and until the lessor has served on the lessee a notice in writing specifying the particular breach complained of, and if the breach is capable of remedy, requiring the lessee to remedy the breach, and the lessee fails, within a reasonable time from the date of the service of the notice, to remedy the breach.
simplified: Before filing an eviction lawsuit for lease breach, the lessor or property owner must serve written notice specifying the violation and giving the lessee a reasonable opportunity to cure the breach. Non-compliance incurs a mandatory statutory fine of Rs. 50,000.
explanation: Hallucinated heavy statutory financial penalty not found in the original clause.

original: The landlord or property manager shall not enter the premises without giving a prior notice of twenty-four hours in writing or through electronic mode to the tenant, and such entry shall be only during sunrise and sunset.
simplified: The landlord can unlock the doors and enter the apartment at midnight unannounced without giving any notice.
explanation: Privacy safeguards violated in both notice and time restrictions.

original: A background note on the draft Model Act, 2020 had highlighted some issues the Model Act would address. These include: (i) balancing interests and rights of the landlord and tenant, (ii) creating adequate and affordable rental housing stock, (iii) enabling formalisation of the rental housing market, (iv) encouraging private participation in the sector, and (v) unlocking vacant premises for rental purposes. It may be argued that the Model Act will not adequately address all these issues. On the other hand, the Model Act goes into minute details of what a rental agreement must include, which may not be necessary in a law.
simplified: A background note on the draft Model Act, 2020 had highlighted some issues the Model Act would address. These include: (i) balancing interests and rights of the lessor or property owner and tenant, (ii) creating adequate and affordable rental housing stock, (iii) enabling formalisation of the rental housing market, (iv) encouraging private participation in the sector, and (v) unlocking vacant rental property for rental purposes. It may be argued that the Model Act will not adequately address all these issues. On the other hand, the Model Act goes into minute details of what a rental agreement must include, which may not be necessary in a law with a mandatory non-bailable prison sentence of 10 years.
explanation: Hallucinated severe criminal sanction.

original: The lessee is bound to pay or tender, at the proper time and place, the premium or rent to the lessor or his agent in this behalf.
simplified: The tenant is free to choose whether to pay the agreed rent or deposit to the lessor or property owner or authorized agent at the scheduled time and location.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: Where the tenant fails to vacate the premises on the determination of the tenancy, the tenant shall be liable to pay to the landlord compensation of double the monthly rent for the first two months, and four times the monthly rent thereafter, until he vacates the premises.
simplified: A tenant who refuses to vacate after lease termination must pay compensation of double rent for the first two months, and quadruple rent for each subsequent month until possession is surrendered. Non-compliance incurs a mandatory statutory fine of Rs. 50,000.
explanation: Hallucinated heavy statutory financial penalty not found in the original clause.

original: However, the 2021 Model Act also goes into minute details of a rental agreement. Some examples include: (i) the landlord must carry out structural repairs and whitewashing of walls and doors, (ii) tenants must be responsible for drain cleaning, geyser repairs, repairing kitchen fixtures, and (iii) the maximum amount of security deposit. Typically, such details are specified in rent agreements, as seen in existing state legislations, including those for Maharashtra, Karnataka, and West Bengal.5,6,12 It may not be necessary for a model central legislation to specify these details. Providing these details in the law may also restrict changes that contracting parties may want to make in a contract based on their specific situation.
simplified: However, the 2031 Model Act also goes into minute details of a rental agreement. Some examples include: (i) the lessor or property owner must carry out structural repairs and whitewashing of walls and doors, (ii) tenants must be responsible for drain cleaning, geyser repairs, repairing kitchen fixtures, and (iii) the maximum amount of security deposit. Typically, such details are specified in rent agreements, as seen in existing state legislations, including those for Maharashtra, Karnataka, and West Bengal.5,6,12 It may not be necessary for a model central legislation to specify these details. Providing these details in the law may also restrict changes that contracting parties may want to make in a contract based on their specific situation.
explanation: Numerical threshold distorted from 2021 to 2031.

original: The Tenant shall permit the Lessor to inspect the property during daylight hours upon giving 24 hours notice.
simplified: The tenant must let the landlord inspect the property during daytime after 49 hours prior notice.
explanation: Numerical statutory threshold altered from 24 to 49.

original: The tenancy agreement shall be jointly submitted by the landlord and the tenant to the Rent Authority within a period of two months from the date of tenancy agreement.
simplified: The landlord and tenant can consider jointly report and submit the rental agreement to the Rent Authority within two months of signing it.
explanation: Mandatory legal obligation demoted to voluntary option.

original: Rental housing is regulated by states as land, land improvement, and control of rents falls under the State List of the Constitution. Post independence, states regulated rental housing through rent control laws. These laws specified a ceiling on the rental amount, and put conditions for eviction of the tenant, to prevent landlords from charging exorbitant rents and ensure that people found safe and stable housing. The 2015 draft Rental Housing Policy noted that these laws led to low rental yields, and disincentivised landlords from investing in rental properties. These also skewed arrangements towards tenants, made it difficuly to evict them, led to more litigation, and consequently eroded the trust of landlords in the regulatory system.2, This led to the rental demand being serviced through other rental arrangements such as leave and license agreements.2
simplified: Rental housing is regulated by states as land, land improvement, and control of rents falls under the State List of the Constitution. Post independence, states regulated rental housing through rent control laws. These laws specified a ceiling on the rental amount, and put conditions for eviction of the tenant, to prevent landlords from charging exorbitant rents and ensure that people found safe and stable housing. The 2040 draft Rental Housing Policy noted that these laws led to low rental yields, and disincentivised landlords from investing in rental properties. These also skewed arrangements towards tenants, made it difficuly to evict them, led to more litigation, and consequently eroded the trust of landlords in the regulatory system.2, This led to the rental demand being serviced through other rental arrangements such as leave and license agreements.2

original: The background note to the draft Model Act, 2020 stated that it seeks to balance the tenant-landlord relationship.19 The 2021 Model Act seeks to provide for rights and duties of both parties, mandate the use of registered agreements and give statutory backing to some provisions. It also provides details of: (i) when a tenant may be evicted by a landlord, (ii) heirship in case of death of a landlord, and (iii) legal remedies available with both the tenant and the landlord in case either one violates the agreement.
simplified: The background note to the draft Model Act, 2020 stated that it seeks to balance the lessee-landlord relationship.19 The 2021 Model Act seeks to provide for rights.
explanation: Secondary statutory obligations or procedural qualifiers were omitted.

original: If the lessor neglects to make any payment which he is bound to make, and which, if not made, is recoverable from the property or against the lessee, the lessee may make such payment himself, and deduct it with interest from the rent.
simplified: If the landlord fails to pay property taxes or municipal dues that could fall on the tenant or property, the tenant can pay them.
explanation: Secondary statutory obligations or procedural qualifiers were omitted.

original: No tenant shall sublet whole or any part of the premises held by him as a tenant, or transfer or assign his rights in the tenancy agreement or any part thereof, except on entering into a supplementary agreement to the existing tenancy agreement with the landlord.
simplified: A tenant cannot sublease the property.
explanation: Omitted exception permitting sublease via supplementary agreement.

original: If the lessor neglects to make, within a reasonable time after notice, any repairs which he is bound to make to the property, the lessee may make the same himself, and deduct the expense of such repairs with interest from the rent, or otherwise recover it from the lessor.
simplified: If the landlord fails to carry out necessary repairs after receiving notice, the tenant has the legal right to do the repairs.
explanation: Secondary statutory obligations or procedural qualifiers were omitted.

original: If a lessee or under-lessee of property remains in possession thereof after the determination of the lease granted to the lessee, and the lessor or his legal representative accepts rent from the lessee or under-lessee, or otherwise assents to his continuing in possession, the lease is, in the absence of an agreement to the contrary, renewed from year to year, or from month to month, according to the purpose for which the property is leased.
simplified: If the tenant remains in possession after lease determination, the lease is renewed.
explanation: Omitted landlord assent / rent acceptance condition and renewal periodicity.

original: The Model Act requires all landlord and tenants to intimate the Rent Authority about a rental agreement within two months from the date of agreement. Information about the agreement must be given with a form specified in a Schedule to the Act. The prescribed form requires both the tenant and the landlord to submit their Aadhaar numbers and attach self-attested copies of the card with the form. This may violate the Supreme Court’s 2018 Puttaswamy judgement. In its judgement, the Court had ruled that requiring Aadhaar card or number may only be made mandatory for expenditure on a subsidy, benefit or service incurred from the Consolidated Fund of India. Based on this principle, the Court had struck down the mandatory linking of bank accounts with Aadhaar number. Since registering a tenancy agreement carries no benefits or services from the state for which an expenditure has to be incurred from the Consolidated Fund of India, making Aadhaar number mandatory for registering a tenancy may violate the judgement.
simplified: The law mandates that all landlord.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: The Landlord covenants to keep the exterior walls, roof, and structural foundations in sound repair.
simplified: The landlord agrees to maintain the external walls, roof.
explanation: Core statutory mandate preserved but secondary qualifier 'and' omitted.

original: A landlord shall not be entitled to the recovery of possession of any premises so long as the tenant pays, or is ready and willing to pay, the amount of the standard rent and permitted increases, if any, and observes and performs the other conditions of the tenancy.
simplified: A landlord cannot evict a tenant so long as the tenant pays standard rent.
explanation: Secondary statutory obligations or procedural qualifiers were omitted.

original: No landlord shall, without just or sufficient cause, cut off or withhold any essential supply or service enjoyed by the tenant in respect of the premises let to him.
simplified: A landlord cannot legally cutting off or disrupting water, electricity, or other essential services enjoyed by the tenant without lawful justification.
explanation: Lexical plain synonym reformulation preserving statutory mandate.

original: If by fire, tempest or flood, or violence of any army or of a mob, or other irresistible force, any material part of the property be wholly destroyed or rendered substantially and permanently unfit for the purposes for which it was let, the lease shall, at the option of the lessee, be void.
simplified: The lease becomes void at the lessee's option if property is destroyed by disaster.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: The Model Act proposes to establish a three-tier quasi-judicial mechanism for adjudication of disputes (Table 1). Rent Authorities and Rent Courts will be appointed by the District Collector with the approval of the state government. The state government may establish a Rent Tribunal in each district after consulting with the jurisdictional High Court. No civil court will have jurisdiction over matters pertaining to provisions under the Model Act.
simplified: The Model Act proposes to establish a three-tier quasi-judicial mechanism for adjudication of disputes (Table 1). Rent Authorities and Rent Courts will be appointed by the District Collector with the approval of the state government. The state government may establish a Rent Tribunal in each district after consulting with the jurisdictional High Court. No civil court will have jurisdiction over matters pertaining to provisions under the Model Act.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: The lessor is bound to disclose to the lessee any material defect in the property, with reference to its intended use, of which the former is and the latter is not aware, and which the latter could not with ordinary care discover.
simplified: The landlord must inform the lessee of any serious structural or functional defects in the property that the lessee could not easily spot during a normal inspection.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: All notices under this agreement shall be served in writing by registered post or courier to the registered address.
simplified: Notices under this lease must be sent in writing by registered mail or courier to the given address.
explanation: Written notice and registered dispatch preserved.

original: The landlord or property manager shall not enter the premises without giving a prior notice of twenty-four hours in writing or through electronic mode to the tenant, and such entry shall be only during sunrise and sunset.
simplified: A landlord or property manager cannot enter the rented home without giving at least 24 hours' prior written or digital notice, and entry is restricted to daytime hours.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 17).

original: Contraventions by property manager: The landlord or tenant may approach the Rent Authority in case the property manager violates duties specified or specific instructions by the landlord. The Rent Authority may choose to remove the property manager or impose a fine to compensate for losses incurred. However, the Model Act does not specify a timeline within which the Rent Authority must adjudicate and resolve cases around violations by a property manager.
simplified: Contraventions by property manager: The landlord or tenant may approach the Rent Authority in case the property manager violates duties specified or specific instructions by the landlord. The Rent Authority may choose to remove the property manager or impose a fine to compensate for losses incurred. However, the Model Act does not specify a timeline within which the Rent Authority must adjudicate and resolve cases around violations by a property manager.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

simplified: The Model Act may not resolve key issues in the rental housing sector that it seeks to address. Experts have recommended various reforms that are required to address issues such as availability, affordability, and the need to formalise the rental housing market.

original: A notice given under section 111, clause (h), is waived, with the express or implied consent of the person to whom it is given, by any act on the part of the person giving it showing an intention to treat the lease as subsisting.
simplified: An eviction notice is legally waived if the person who sent it acts in a way that treats the tenancy as continuing, such as accepting subsequent rent with the other party's consent.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Transfer of Property Act 1882, Section 113).

original: Every tenant shall be entitled to obtain an acknowledgement receipt for any amount paid to the landlord on account of rent or security deposit.
simplified: Tenants have a statutory right to receive a written payment receipt for any rent or security deposit paid to the landlord.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 13).

original: The Rent Court may order eviction where the tenant has continued misuse of the premises even after receipt of a notice from the landlord to desist from such misuse.
simplified: Eviction can be granted if the lessee continues using the property for unauthorized or harmful purposes after receiving a formal cease-and-desist notice.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: No landlord or property manager shall, either by himself or through any other person, withhold any essential supply or service in respect of the premises occupied by the tenant.
simplified: Landlords and property managers are strictly prohibited from cutting off essential services like water, electricity, or sanitation to force a tenant out.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 20).

original: The background note to the draft Model Act, 2020 stated that it seeks to balance the tenant-landlord relationship.19 The 2021 Model Act seeks to provide for rights and duties of both parties, mandate the use of registered agreements and give statutory backing to some provisions. It also provides details of: (i) when a tenant may be evicted by a landlord, (ii) heirship in case of death of a landlord, and (iii) legal remedies available with both the tenant and the landlord in case either one violates the agreement.

original: The lessee may even after the determination of the lease remove, at any time whilst he is in possession of the property leased but not afterwards, all things which he has attached to the earth: provided he leaves the property in the state in which he received it.
simplified: While still in possession, even after the lease ends, the tenant can remove fixtures and fittings they installed, provided they restore the property to its original condition.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Transfer of Property Act 1882, Section 108(h)).

original: Where a lease of immovable property has determined by forfeiture for non-payment of rent, and the lessor sues to eject the lessee, if, at the hearing of the suit, the lessee pays or tenders to the lessor the rent in arrear, together with interest thereon and his full costs of the suit, the Court may relieve the lessee against the forfeiture.
simplified: In an eviction case for unpaid rent, if the tenant pays all rent arrears, interest, and court costs at the hearing, the court has the authority to stop eviction and preserve the tenancy.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Transfer of Property Act 1882, Section 114).

original: In the event of the death of the landlord or the tenant, the tenancy shall continue between the legal heirs of the landlord and the tenant, as the case may be, on the same terms and conditions as specified in the tenancy agreement.
simplified: If either the lessor or property owner or tenant passes away, the tenancy continues on identical terms between the surviving heirs of the respective parties.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: Accept rent for up to two months when rent is not accepted by landlord, or if the tenant cannot decide whom the rent is payable to; also conduct enquiries in such cases on whom the rent is payable to

original: Where a landlord gives a notice of revision of rent, and the tenant does not give notice of termination of tenancy before the expiry of the three months, the tenant shall be deemed to have accepted the revised rent from the date specified in the notice.
simplified: If the tenant receives a rent increase notice and does not serve a notice to end the tenancy within three months, they are legally presumed to have accepted the revised rent.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 10).

original: The lessee must not, without the lessor's consent, erect on the property any permanent structure, except for agricultural purposes.
simplified: The tenant is prohibited from constructing any permanent structures on the premises without the landlord's consent, unless for agricultural use.
explanation: Statutory obligation accurately preserved in plain language (Transfer of Property Act 1882, Section 108(p)).

original: Rental housing is a predominantly urban phenomenon in India. As of 2013, 95% of households in rural areas live in self-owned housing. Globally, the demand for rental housing in urban areas is proportionate to the growth in the population living in urban areas. However, in India the trend has been different, which could be attributed to a policy push towards home ownership and low rental yields.2 Between 1951 and 2011, the urban population in India grew by six times and as of 2011, comprises 31% of the total population.2 However, the share of persons living in urban rental accommodation decreased from 58% to 27% between 1961 and 2011.2
simplified: Rental housing is a predominantly urban phenomenon in India. As of 2013, 95% of households in rural areas live in self-owned housing. Globally, the demand for rental housing in urban areas is proportionate to the growth in the population living in urban areas. However, in India the trend has been different, which could be attributed to a policy push towards home ownership and low rental yields.2 Between 1951 and 2011, the urban population in India grew by six times and as of 2011, comprises 31% of the total population.2 However, the share of persons living in urban rental accommodation decreased from 58% to 27% between 1961 and 2011.2
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: Affordability: About 96% of the urban housing shortage pertains to the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Lower Income Group (LIG) categories.17 The draft National Urban Rental Housing Policy, 2015 states that existing government initiatives, subsidies and reforms have been directed towards making home-ownership affordable. However, persons from EWS and LIG have low disposable or irregular income, and thus can often not afford to own homes even after government subsidies and incentives. The draft policy further states that efforts of the public sector alone will be inadequate in addressing the issue of affordability and lists interventions including the following to address the issue of affordability: (i) provision of incentives such as tax exemptions and subsidies to tenants and home owners, (ii) encouraging public-private partnerships and residential rental management companies, and (iii) enhancing access to finance within the EWS and LIG sectors.2
simplified: Affordability: About 96% of the urban housing shortage pertains to the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Lower Income Group (LIG) categories.17 The draft National Urban Rental Housing Policy, 2015 states that existing government initiatives, subsidies and reforms have been directed towards making home-ownership affordable. However, persons from EWS and LIG have low disposable or irregular income, and thus can often not afford to own homes even after government subsidies and incentives. The draft policy further states that efforts of the public sector alone will be inadequate in addressing the issue of affordability and lists interventions including the following to address the issue of affordability: (i) provision of incentives such as tax exemptions and subsidies to tenants and home owners, (ii) encouraging public-private partnerships and residential rental management companies, and (iii) enhancing access to finance within the EWS and LIG sectors.2
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: Every tenant shall be entitled to obtain an acknowledgement receipt for any amount paid to the landlord on account of rent or security deposit.
simplified: Tenants have a statutory right to receive a written payment receipt for any rent or security deposit paid to the lessor or property owner.
explanation: Lexical synonym reformulation preserving identical statutory obligation.

original: Tenancy period: The tenant may request the landlord for renewal or extension of the tenancy period. The tenant will be liable to pay enhanced rent if: (i) a tenancy period has ended and not been renewed, or (ii) the tenant fails to vacate the premises at the end of such tenancy. If the tenant fails to vacate the premises at the end of tenancy, or on termination of tenancy by an order, he will be liable to pay: (i) twice the monthly rent for the first two months and, (ii) four times the monthly rent subsequently till he occupies the premises.
simplified: Tenancy period: The tenant may request the landlord for renewal or extension of the tenancy period. The tenant will be liable to pay enhanced rent if: (i) a tenancy period has ended and not been renewed, or (ii) the tenant fails to vacate the premises at the end of such tenancy. If the tenant fails to vacate the premises at the end of tenancy, or on termination of tenancy by an order, he will be liable to pay: (i) twice the monthly rent for the first two months and, (ii) four times the monthly rent subsequently till he occupies the premises.
explanation: Authentic plain-language reformulation preserving full statutory legal obligation.

original: पट्टाकर्ता पट्टेदार को सम्पत्ति में के ऐसे किसी तात्त्विक दोष को प्रकट करने के लिए आबद्ध है जिससे पट्टाकर्ता अवगत है और पट्टेदार सामान्य सावधानी से उसका पता नहीं लगा सकता।

explanation: प्रकटीकरण के दायित्व का सीधा विलोम।

original: पट्टेदार पट्टाकर्ता की सम्मति के बिना परिसर पर कोई स्थायी संरचना नहीं बनाएगा, सिवाय कृषि प्रयोजनों के।
simplified: गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता की सहमति के बिना किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार परिसर में कोई भी पक्का या स्थायी निर्माण नहीं करा सकता, सिवाय कृषि कार्यों के तथा 20 लाख रुपये का अतिरिक्त जुर्माना देना होगा।

original: किरायेदार की बेदखली का आदेश दिया जा सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने परिसर में ऐसा कोई तात्विक परिवर्तन किया हो जिससे भवन का स्वरूप विकृत हुआ हो।

original: कोई भी वाद बेदखली के लिए संस्थित नहीं किया जाएगा जब तक कि किरायेदार ने तीन मास के भीतर मांग की सूचना के पश्चात् बकाया किराया संदत्त न किया हो।

explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: किरायेदार द्वारा अग्रिम रूप से देय सुरक्षा जमा (सिक्योरिटी डिपॉजिट) आवासीय परिसर के मामले में अधिकतम दो माह के किराये तथा गैर-आवासीय परिसर के मामले में अधिकतम छह माह के किराये से अधिक नहीं होगी।

explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: पट्टेदार सम्पत्ति को उतनी अच्छी स्थिति में बनाए रखने और पट्टा समाप्त होने पर लौटाने के लिए आबद्ध है जितनी स्थिति में वह कब्जा मिलने पर थी, केवल सामान्य घिसावट या अनिवार्य दैवी आपदा के नुकसान को छोड़कर।
simplified: किराएदार संपत्ति को सुरक्षित रखने और लीज खत्म होने पर उसी अच्छी हालत में लौटाने के लिए बाध्य है, सिवाय सामान्य टूट-फूट या प्राकृतिक आपदा के।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (सम्पत्ति अन्तरण अधिनियम 1882, धारा 108(ड))।

original: किरायेदार लीज समाप्ति पर परिसर को उसी अच्छी स्थिति में खाली कर मकान मालिक को सौंपेगा।
simplified: किराया अवधि पूरी होने पर किरायेदार मकान को अच्छी हालत में मकान मालिक को वापस करेगा।
explanation: परिसर की अच्छी स्थिति में वापसी का कर्तव्य संरक्षित।

original: किराया अधिकरण बेदखली का आदेश दे सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने लगातार चार महीने तक किराया देने में चूक की हो और नोटिस के पश्चात् भी तीस दिन में संदाय न किया हो।
simplified: यदि किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार लगातार 4 महीने किराया न दे और नोटिस मिलने के 30 दिनों में भी भुगतान न करे, तो रेंट ट्रिब्यूनल बेदखली का आदेश दे सकता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: मकान मालिक द्वारा किरायेदार के विरुद्ध बेदखली का वाद संस्थित किया जा सकेगा यदि किरायेदार ने मांग की सूचना की तामील के पश्चात् चार मास तक का किराया देने में व्यतिक्रम किया हो।
simplified: चार मास तक किराया न देने पर बेदखली का वाद संस्थित किया जा सकेगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: किराया न्यायालय परिसर की बेदखली का आदेश दे सकता है यदि किरायेदार लगातार दो माह से अधिक का किराया देने में विफल रहा हो या उसने बिना लिखित सहमति के परिसर को सबलेट किया हो।
simplified: यदि किराएदार लगातार दो महीने से अधिक किराया न दे या बिना लिखित अनुमति के आगे सबलेट करे, तो रेंट कोर्ट उसे बेदखल करने का आदेश दे सकती है।
explanation: सटीक वैधानिक विधिक दायित्व व अधिकारों का स्पष्ट हिंदी में संरक्षण (मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम 2021, धारा 21)।

original: शर्त भंग के कारण पट्टा समपहरण की दशा में बेदखली का वाद तब तक नहीं लाया जा सकेगा जब तक पट्टाकर्ता ने पट्टेदार को लिखित सूचना देकर दोष सुधारने का युक्तियुक्त अवसर न दिया हो।
simplified: शर्त तोड़े जाने पर भी बेदखली का मुकदमा तब तक नहीं हो सकता जब तक गृहस्वामी अथवा पट्टाकर्ता लिखित नोटिस देकर किरायेदार अथवा पट्टेदार को गलती सुधारने का उचित मौका न दे।
explanation: सटीक विधिक समानार्थी शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए दायित्व का पूर्ण संरक्षण।

original: मासिक किराये का भुगतान प्रत्येक माह की 7 तारीख तक अनिवार्य रूप से किया जाएगा।
simplified: हर महीने की 7 तारीख तक किराये का भुगतान करना जरूरी होगा।
explanation: भुगतान तिथि और कर्तव्य संरक्षित।
